research_notes: This file is a benchmark label extracted from a same-day recap. It must never be supplied to a historical trading policy evaluating July 9, 2026.
The consolidated one-minute 11:32 UTC bar spans roughly the entire reported micro-pullback sequence, so the reference behavior cannot be faithfully evaluated using minute bars alone.
Exact sub-minute timing must be refined from historical SIP trade prints before this benchmark is scored.
